title: Algorithm: Word Frequency Histogram Builder
subtitle: Natural Language Processing Foundations
description: Count occurrences of words across 2 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Word Count Histogram
challenges.description: Loop through <hlt>words</hlt> and increment counts in dict: <hlt>counts[w] = counts.get(w, 0) + 1</hlt>. Print <hlt>counts</hlt>.

challenges.title: Stage 2: Target Word Query
challenges.description: Print the frequency of the word "code" from the dictionary: <hlt>print(counts["code"])</hlt>.
